summary_markdown: A follow-up discussion regarding the aggregated historical data for Innovocean. It was determined that creating a fully functional and usable history from the restricted dataset is not feasible due to cost constraints. Instead, focusing on a detailed sample of the lowest level of data was suggested. This approach aims to determine if the data quality is sufficient for direct 1-to-1 import into the system with minimal transformations.
decisions: Focus analysis on a highly detailed sample of the available historical data.
